name: Anselm Roth
background: the railway itself — he cannot remember working anywhere else, or being anywhere else
appearance: a train guard's uniform gone grey with dust, one sleeve dark with dried blood

memories.text: Signing on with the company as a young man, at a recruiting office with no address.
The name of the last station this train actually stopped at. It is on the tip of his tongue. It has been for years.
He remembers checking your tickets — all of you — on the night you boarded. None of you remember boarding.

recruit_text: Anselm Roth, wounded train guard. Knows the train's procedures. Bleeding steadily.

name: Petra Illes
background: the dining car's kitchen, from which she resigned by walking out mid-service and never looking back
appearance: whites gone grey, forearms scarred by decades of oven burns, eyes that have seen the pantry

memories.text: The first meal she ever cooked aboard: consommé, for four hundred silent covers.
What she saw in the pantry. There is only the walking-away part left.
She remembers feeding one of you before, years ago, and that you sent your compliments.

recruit_text: Petra Illes, a cook who refuses to enter the dining car. Knows what the kitchen serves.
